app.title: Patient Time Log
arm.means: Arming says she will be there. The check-in is made on her behalf at the scheduled minute.
arm.note: An armed visit is checked in automatically at its scheduled minute. Everything starts off, and off is the safe state — turn one on only when she really will be at that home.
arm.title: Auto-entry
arm.why.app_not_walked: This app has not been mapped yet — arming it will not press anything.
arm.why.control_not_walked: The check-in for this app has not been mapped yet — arming it will not press anything.
arm.why.entry_is_the_first_half: The check-in belongs to the first half of this visit, at {other}. Nothing is entered here.
choice.gps_warning: Choosing location will ask the phone where it is, and the phone is not with you.
choice.only_offered: Only the options the app itself is showing can be chosen here.
choice.prompt: The app is offering these. Choose how this visit should be verified.
choice.title: How should this visit be verified?
code.copy: Tap the code to copy it
code.copy_failed: Could not copy. Read it off the screen instead.
code.failed: Could not reach the phone to read the code.
code.nobody: Nobody is set up to receive the code yet.
code.none: No recent sign-in code on the phone. Start a sign-in first, then press this again.
code.sent: Code sent to {n} of {of} phones. Check your messages.
console.density.applies_to_rest: Applies to whatever the phone is showing that is not one of the four apps.
console.density.clear_note: Clearing puts back the value the app was tuned to. Those are never overwritten, so there is always a way back.
console.density.explain: Smaller numbers fit more on the screen. It will not go below {floor} — that is not a preference, it is the value that crashed the phone. The top is {ceiling}.
console.density.from_phone: whatever the phone was left on
console.density.pending: not applied yet — choose where it applies
console.density.title: How big the phone's text is
console.live.hers_note: Her page, live — the same one she is using, not a copy of it.
console.live.title: Live
console.phone.title: The phone
console.phone.versions_explain: The build of each app the portal is reading. An app that changed in the last week is marked — that is the first thing to check when something that worked yesterday does not.
console.pi.title: The controller
console.services.title: Services
console.title: Control centre
console.tree.empty: The phone has not reported a screen yet.
console.tree.explain: Every row the phone reported, tappable and not, in the order they sit on the glass. The phone view folds and tidies this; here nothing is hidden, so you can see what she is missing.
console.tree.title: The screen, unabridged
console.tree.whole_page: the whole page, not just what fits
console.who.empty: Nobody else has opened this recently.
console.who.explain: This list is named by the link each phone opens — add ?who=Sadia to the address saved on its home screen. Nothing else is stored about a device: no location, no account, nothing to sign in to.
console.who.title: Who is on
control.paused_notice: The schedule is paused. Nothing will be recorded until you resume it.
debug.intro: The phone's own Settings, mapped to this page: open a screen, watch it on the mirror, tap it through. For the person maintaining the machine, not for visits.
debug.language_note: To change the phone's language: open Language & input, then tap through the phone's own list on the picture above. The portal's language is the EN/ES switch in the top bar — the two are separate.
debug.look_again: The screen moved on — aim again.
debug.open_unknown: That is not a screen this page can open.
debug.opened: Opening {panel} on the phone — drive it on the picture below.
debug.panels.explain: Each button opens one screen of the phone's own Settings, and that screen is then driven on the picture above. Only the screens on this list can be opened — everything else stays out of reach on purpose.
debug.panels.title: Open a settings screen
debug.readings.explain: Read from the phone over adb. Apart from the clock section, nothing on this page writes a value directly — to change one, open its screen above and press the phone's own control for it.
debug.readings.title: What the phone says now
debug.readings.unreachable: The phone did not answer, so these values could not be read.
debug.saved.clock: Setting the clock — Mobile Caregiver+ restarts if it is open.
debug.saved.reset: Putting the clock back on automatic — Mobile Caregiver+ restarts if it is open.
debug.saved.switch: Saved — the phone took the switch.
debug.screen.explain: Tap a highlighted box to press that control on the phone. If the screen has moved on, the tap is refused and the picture refreshes — aim again.
debug.screen.title: The phone screen
debug.time.bad: That time could not be read — nothing was changed.
debug.time.explain: Two switches and a clock, written straight to the phone — no tapping through Settings. Careful: every visit record rides this clock, so put it back the way it was when you are done.
debug.time.reset_note: One press undoes this whole section: both switches go back on and the network restores the real time and zone, usually within seconds — watch the clock above. Press it when you are done testing, every time.
debug.time.set_note: The time you type is read in the phone's own time zone. Setting the clock turns Automatic date & time off first — with it on, the network puts the time straight back. Switch it back on above when you are done.
debug.time.title: The phone's clock
debug.title: Settings debugger
debug.toast.opened: Opening it on the phone — watch the screen above.
debug.warning: Careful in Connections and Developer options: Wi-Fi and USB debugging are what connect this portal to the phone, and turning either off cuts the portal off until somebody in the room turns it back on.
error.unavailable: This information is not available right now.
gate.dev_transport: Development mode: the phone is connected over the network, not by cable. Visits cannot be submitted in this mode.
gate.refused: The phone cannot be confirmed at the building, so nothing was recorded.
health.problem: Something needs attention. Nothing has been recorded incorrectly.
health.title: Is everything working?
macro.clock_reset: Put the clock back on automatic
macro.evv_checks: Show what is recorded for this visit today
macro.evv_prepare: Open this visit ready to check in
macro.explain: These do the tedious steps for you. They never clock a visit in or out — that stays your tap, on the screen above.
macro.reboot_note: Restarting the phone takes about a minute, during which nothing here works. It comes back on its own.
macro.started: Started. Watch the phone screen below.
macro.state.failed: That did not finish. Have a look at the phone screen above.
macro.step.awaiting_code: Waiting for the app to ask for the code…
macro.step.clock_reset: Putting the clock back on automatic before opening…
macro.step.clock_resetting: Putting the clock back on automatic…
macro.step.clock_restart: Restarting the app so it reads the new time…
macro.step.freshening: Reopening the app so today is up to date…
macro.step.installing: Installing — this can take a few minutes…
macro.step.landing: Making sure the right app is in front…
macro.step.nothing_to_check: Every required task is already ticked.
macro.step.update_required: This app is asking to be updated. Use the update button on the app page — it cannot be signed into until then.
macro.step.updating: Asking the Play Store to update…
macro.sure.inmyteam_resend_code: Ask inMyTeam for a new code? It closes the app, signs in again and sends a new text. The code you already have stops working.
macro.sure.restart_phone: Restart the phone? Nothing works for about a minute while it comes back.
macro.sure.update_app: Update this app from the Play Store? It replaces the version on the phone and cannot be undone — do it when somebody can check the app afterwards.
macro.title: Shortcuts
macro.unknown: That shortcut is not one this page offers.
mirror.for_patient: This is for your visit with {patient}.
mirror.screen.home: It is on the main menu.
mirror.screen.language: It is on the language screen.
mirror.screen.permissions: It is answering the app's permission questions.
mirror.screen.signature: It is at the signature step.
mirror.screen.today: It is on today's visit list.
mirror.screen.unknown: It is on a screen it did not recognise.
mirror.screen.verification: It is at the question of how to verify the visit.
mirror.step.blocked: It has stopped and cannot continue on its own.
mirror.step.idle: It is waiting for the next scheduled visit.
mirror.step.unknown: It did not report what it is doing.
mirror.step.waiting: It has stopped and is waiting for your answer.
mirror.unreported: The controller has not reported what it is doing.
otp.expires: Codes expire quickly, so this request closes after a few minutes. If it does, nothing was sent and you can ignore it.
otp.label: Code
otp.prompt: {app} just texted you a code. Enter it here so the controller can sign in.
otp.title: Login code
papp.app_home: Back to this app's first page
papp.asleep_hint: Wake it to see and use it from here.
papp.authstop.credentials_refused: The app refused the password. Check the credentials on the controller, then turn it back on.
papp.authstop.title: Automatic sign-in for {app} is off
papp.authstop.too_many_failures: It failed three times in a row and stood down. It tries again on its own after two hours — or right now if you turn it back on.
papp.choose: Choose an app. It opens on the phone in Florida, and this page becomes its screen.
papp.clock.done: The clock is set. Mobile Caregiver+ will restart when opened.
papp.clock.explain: This is the phone's own time, not yours. Setting it turns automatic time off, and Mobile Caregiver+ is restarted so it reads the new time. HHAeXchange+ and inMyTeam put the clock back on automatic when they open.
papp.clock.title: The phone's clock
papp.clock.unconfirmed: The phone has not confirmed the change yet — check the clock.
papp.clock.working: Changing the phone's clock — nothing else until it is done…
papp.coach_held: Watch-only is on — nothing here reaches the phone.
papp.covered: Something is covering the phone's screen.
papp.covered_hint: Nothing you tap will reach the app until it is cleared.
papp.expired_hint: The app will not accept it. Ask for a new one and it will text you another.
papp.explain.live: Green: this page matches the phone in Florida right now.
papp.explain.offline: Red: not connected to the controller. It reconnects on its own; nothing tapped here reaches the phone until it does.
papp.explain.syncing: Yellow: the phone's screen is changing — showing the loading page until the fresh screen arrives.
papp.last_seen: Last on screen before it turned off:
papp.on_launcher: The phone is on its home screen.
papp.on_launcher_hint: Go back to the app you were using, or choose another one.
papp.type.hint: Type here, then send it to the phone
papp.walled: This app is asking to be updated.
papp.walled_hint: It will not do anything else until a newer version is installed.
papp.watchers: How many people are on this portal
papp.web_partial: This is a web page — it may show more than this list. The photo (eye button) has the whole screen.
phone.app_says: The app is showing this message:
phone.blocked: The app does not allow pictures of this screen.
phone.blocked.app_not_responding: The app stopped responding. Nothing on this screen can be tapped — the controller is restarting the app, which takes a few seconds.
phone.blocked.capture_failed: The picture of this screen could not be taken. The buttons below are what is on it, and they still work.
phone.blocked.login_activity: This is a sign-in screen, so no picture of it is shown. The buttons below are what is on it, and they still work.
phone.blocked.no_focus: The controller cannot tell what the phone is showing, so it is not showing you a picture.
phone.blocked.other: There is no picture of this screen. The buttons below are what is on it, and they still work.
phone.blocked.password_field: There is a password box on this screen, so no picture of it is shown. The buttons below are what is on it, and they still work.
phone.blocked.secure_screen: The app does not allow pictures of this screen. The buttons below are what is on it, and they still work.
phone.nav_note: These work even when the screen has no way out of its own.
phone.none: No recent picture of the phone screen.
phone.out_of_date: This picture is out of date. The controller has not reported in since {time}.
phone.title: What the phone sees
phone.wake_note: Turns the screen on. It cannot do anything else.
portal.failed: That did not reach the phone.
portal.instruction: Tap anything on the phone screen below.
portal.moved: The screen changed — here it is again. Tap once more.
portal.offline: Not connected to the controller. This picture is frozen and tapping is turned off. It will reconnect on its own; pull down to reload if it does not.
push.auth_stopped.body: {app} could not be signed back in and the automatic sign-in stood down. Tap to open the portal and turn it back on.
push.auth_stopped.title: {app}: automatic sign-in stopped
relay.expired: That request is no longer open. If it is still needed, a new one will appear.
relay.for_visit: For your visit with {patient}, scheduled for {time}.
relay.for_visit_untimed: For your visit with {patient}. The controller did not report a scheduled time.
relay.none: Nothing needs your answer right now.
relay.refused: That answer was not accepted. Please check it and try again.
relay.title: The controller needs you
scan.empty: Nothing readable was found on this page.
scan.title: The whole page
sched.none_configured: No schedule has been set up on this controller yet.
sched.title: Schedule
sched.unreadable: The schedule could not be read
screen.trail: Where you are in the app
sigmap.enrol_note: Register a signature. The person it belongs to draws it here, once, in person. Afterwards they apply it themselves with a single press.
sigmap.forgotten: Signature removed. Nothing is left on the machine.
sigmap.nobody: No patients on the schedule and nothing adopted yet.
sigmap.note: Everyone the schedule will ask to sign, and whether they have registered a signature. Registering one is done with the person there, drawing it themselves.
sigmap.saved_for: Saved for {who}. This is what was stored.
sigmap.title: Signatures
sign.adopt_gone: That saved signature is gone. Sign by hand on the pad instead.
sign.adopt_hint: For a patient who cannot hold the phone steady. They sign once here, with you present, and after that their signature goes on with a single press — pressed by them, at the visit.
sign.adopt_need_name: Say whose signature this is first.
sign.adopt_no_store: The controller could not save the signature to its own store. Nothing was recorded — this is the Pi, not the phone.
sign.adopt_saved: Saved. It can be applied with one press from now on.
sign.ambiguous: The controller could not tell which part of this screen is the signature box, so it drew nothing.
sign.instruction: Sign here with your finger. It will be drawn onto the phone's signature box — then check the screen and press the app's own save button.
sign.lock_lapsed: The phone never said whether the drawing finished. Check the phone's screen before saving.
sign.no_canvas: This screen has no signature box. Open the app's signature screen first, then sign here.
sign.now_press: Now finish on the phone, using the button below.
sign.pad_drives: This screen's buttons are in the pencil. Open it to sign and finish.
sign.pad_stuck: The pad will not close — restart the app
sign.replay_failed: The drawing did not finish. Look at the phone screen — if it is half-drawn, clear it in the app and send again.
sign.state.clear.done: Cleared — the phone's signature box is empty again.
sign.state.done: Drawn. Check the phone screen, then press the app's own save button.
sign.state.failed: That did not reach the phone.
sign.state.running: Drawing your signature on the phone…
sign.wait_phone: Your signature is being drawn on the phone. These buttons come back when it has finished.
sign.whose: This screen is asking for {who}'s signature.
sign.wrong_app: The phone is not showing one of the care apps, so nothing was drawn.
signature.expired: This request has expired. A new one will appear if it is still needed.
signature.failed: The signature could not be sent. Please sign again.
signature.instruction: Sign in the box below using your finger.
signature.none: No signature is being requested right now.
signature.prompt: Sign to confirm your visit with {patient}, scheduled for {time}.
signature.title: Signature needed
token.gate_note: This code does not say where you are. Whether a visit is recorded still depends on the controller confirming the phone is at the building.
token.invalid: A token is a short code of letters and numbers.
token.label: Code
token.prompt: Enter the code shown on your token device.
token.title: Security token
token.why: The phone is not with you, so it cannot answer the app's location check. The code from your token device answers it instead.
